mainEntity.name: Copyfy or Spysales: which one is the best?

acceptedAnswer.text: It all depends on your need. Copyfy is better for running an e-commerce business from A to Z: AI product research, store analysis, generated product pages and visual import to Shopify. Spysales is better if you only want to track competing Shopify stores' sales in real time. To launch and run a store, Copyfy wins; for pure sales tracking, Spysales stays solid.

On the sticker price, yes (39$/month against 49€/month). On the real cost of your stack, no: Spysales only covers store sales tracking, so you have to add other subscriptions to launch a store, while Copyfy does the whole job for 49€/month with a 5-day trial and no credit card.

mainEntity.name: Which one has the best product research?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy. Its AI targets winning products directly and analyzes competitor stores, whereas Spysales infers opportunities through its Magic Search based on sales tracking. To move fast toward a product to launch, Copyfy's approach is more direct and more complete.

For most dropshippers, yes. Copyfy covers product research, competitor analysis, product pages and Shopify integration. Spysales keeps the edge on the accuracy of real-time sales tracking via the Facebook pixel: if that monitoring is your core business, it complements Copyfy well.

mainEntity.name: Can you test these tools for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy offers a 5-day free trial, no credit card, plus a 5-day free trial. Spysales offers no free trial and caps its guarantee at 14 days. The simplest is to test Copyfy for free to see if the suite covers your need.
